About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: OSS PreSales Architect
description:

Role: Pre-Sales Solution Architect

Location: LATM Region

Responsibilities:

• Act as the lead OSS solution architect across the full pre-sales lifecycle – from opportunity

qualification and technical discovery through proof-of-concept, proposal, and contract

award – partnering closely with Sales leadership to shape, qualify, and grow the regional

pipeline.

• Own and orchestrate end-to-end responses to RFx (RFI / RFP / RFQ), including solution

design, compliance and traceability matrices, win themes, technical narratives, effort and

Bill-of-Materials estimation, assumptions, and risk identification – driving on-time, high-

quality, fully compliant submissions.

• Design and articulate end-to-end OSS solution architectures spanning Service Assurance,

Service Orchestration & Fulfilment, Inventory, and closed-loop automation, mapping

theCompany portfolio to operator pain points and measurable business outcomes.

• Position and demonstrate the Service Assurance portfolio – fault, performance, and service-

quality management; AI/ML-driven anomaly detection, alarm correlation and noise

reduction; automated root-cause analysis; and predictive, proactive assurance – including

customer-experience and network-slice assurance for 5G Standalone.

• Develop solutions, value cases, and demonstrations around SMO (Service Management &

Orchestration) and RIC (RAN Intelligent Controller) platforms, including the Non-RT RIC and

rApps (R1, A1 interfaces) and the Near-RT RIC and xApps (E2 interface), addressing use cases

such as RAN energy savings, traffic steering, QoE optimization, massive-MIMO and

interference management, and anomaly detection.

• Champion network automation and autonomy – closed-loop operations, intent-based and

intent-driven management, and the journey toward TM Forum Level 4 autonomous

networks – and translate these capabilities into concrete, quantifiable value propositions for

customers.

• Lead technical proofs-of-concept, lab trials, product demonstrations, and solution

integration and validation, tailoring demo environments to each customer’s specific use

cases, KPIs, and success criteria.

• Be responsible and accountable for authoring technical solution documents, high-level

designs, design proposals, sizing and Bill-of-Materials, and TCO / ROI models that withstand

customer and third-party technical scrutiny.

• Serve as the trusted technical advisor to customers and prospects – running discovery

workshops, executive briefings, and technical deep-dives – and manage technical

stakeholder relationships from engineering and operations teams up to C-level.

• Work cross-functionally with internal teams – Product Management, Engineering, Delivery /

Professional Services, Commercial, and Bid Management – and with external parties –

operators, system integrators, hyperscalers, and O-RAN / ecosystem partners – to assemble

winning and deliverable solutions.

• Generate thought-leadership content – white papers, blogs, reference architectures, and

webinars – and representCompany at industry events and standards / community forums

such as TM Forum and the O-RAN ALLIANCE.

• Stay ahead of telecom market trends – Open RAN, 5G and 5G-Advanced, cloud-native CNFs

and Kubernetes, observability and telemetry, GenAI and agentic AI for operations, and the

shift toward data-driven, autonomous networks – and bring that insight into customer

conversations and internal strategy.

Requirements:

• Must-have demonstrable skills & expertise:• Exceptional verbal and written communication, executive presentation, and

storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear

business value.

• Proven hands-on pre-sales and solution-architecture experience in the OSS domain

for mobile operators and/or telecommunication vendors, including ownership of RFx

responses and customer-facing technical engagements.

• Deep, demonstrable expertise across the Service Assurance domain – fault,

performance, and service-quality management, customer-experience management,

and AI/ML-driven assurance (anomaly detection, correlation, automated root-cause

analysis, and predictive / proactive assurance).

• Strong working knowledge of network automation and autonomy – closed-loop

assurance and orchestration, intent-based operations, and the TM Forum

Autonomous Networks framework (Levels 0–5).

• Familiarity with O-RAN architecture and SMO / RIC platforms, including the Non-RT

RIC (rApps, R1, A1), the Near-RT RIC (xApps, E2), and the O1 / O2 management

interfaces.

• Exposure to public clouds (GCP, Azure, and AWS) and to cloud service models (IaaS,

PaaS, DBaaS), with an appreciation of hybrid / multi-cloud and O-Cloud deployment

models.

• Working knowledge of TM Forum standards and Open APIs / Open Digital

Architecture (ODA), and of data and observability technologies (streaming pipelines,

telemetry, and data lakes).

• Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate virtual, cross-functional bid and

solution teams across multiple geographies and time zones, and to manage internal

and external stakeholders.

• Willingness to travel as required.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst - Portuguese em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

  • We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!
  • Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

  • You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:
  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day?
  • Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking: Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment: Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Senior Technical Product Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Technical Product Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*Please not that this is a 8month temp-to-perm independent contract



About hirework s

hireworks is building a community of top talent in key international markets by unlocking unparalleled access to positions at leading U.S. based companies. As your employer, hireworks will ensure you have a seamless interview, onboarding, and employee experience - providing ongoing support and resources along the way. Established in 2023, hireworks is forging corp-to-corp relationships with leading U.S. based organizations looking to grow their teams with best-in-class talent around the world. Working with hireworks means unlocking access to a network of local peers and mentors and career opportunities through our client network.


About Our Client & The Engagemen t

Our client is a premier AI consulting group that builds serious, production-grade systems for companies ready to operationalize artificial intelligence across their business. They eschew gimmicks and prototypes, focusing instead on delivering custom AI that integrates seamlessly into operations to drive measurable results. Their work automates high-effort workflows, launches AI-powered product lines, and transforms internal data into structured, usable assets—ranging from custom-trained models to intelligent agents that reason across complex business logic. Their diverse clientele spans education, financial services, engineering, healthcare, and defense


About the Engagement

A multi-component platform build for an education-sector client: a cloud-native system that ingests school and rostering data into one canonical record, governs access down to the row and field, fronts it behind a single access layer, builds audiences from it, and delivers multi-channel communications to families at scale. It ships as five interlocking components, each with its own scope: a canonical data integration and migration platform; a capability-based access-control service; a unified API access layer over the core; an audience service; and an event-driven communications platform with consent and reporting. We are hiring two senior, interchangeable technical PMs. Each owns one or more components end to end and flexes across all five. You won't inherit a finished roadmap: you'll author scope, sequence delivery across interdependent teams, steer architecture with engineering, and run sign-off and rollout with the client.


What You Will Own

  • Turn ambiguous, architecture-heavy scope into sequenced roadmaps with clear milestones and acceptance criteria.
  • Govern scope and change as designs evolve through discovery, validation, and performance testing.
  • Hold the contracts and sequencing across deeply interdependent component teams.
  • Run client sign-off on schemas, policy models, SLAs, and migration cutover gates.
  • Define and track delivery metrics: success and lag rates, latency, dead-letters, and reconciliation tolerances.
  • Own phased rollout and migration per client: shadow mode, dual-run, cutover, and rollback.
  • Treat compliance as product requirements: FERPA, COPPA, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA, TCPA, SOC 2, and data residency.
  • Partner with the client's product and engineering teams on PRDs, governance rules, and vendor selection.

Responsibilities

  • Own one or more components end to end: scope, roadmap, sequencing, risk, and client sign-off.
  • Author each component's scope and architecture narrative, and shepherd changes through client review.
  • Keep the interfaces between components coherent so dependent teams stay unblocked.
  • Set and hold acceptance criteria and quality gates for production-grade delivery.
  • Drive the migration and rollout playbook as reusable tooling: discovery, mapping, dual-run, cutover, rollback.
  • Translate between client business rules and engineering trade-offs: delivery semantics, replay, caching, latency.
  • Track delivery health against SLAs and surface risk early with clear recommendations.
  • Operate as a peer to senior engineering and client leadership in design reviews and sign-offs.

Required Experience

  • 8+ years in product management, several as a senior, principal, or staff technical PM on platform or data-infrastructure products.
  • Track record shipping complex backend or platform products to production at scale (data, API, identity/auth, segmentation, or messaging).

description:

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

  • We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!
  • Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

  • You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:
  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day?
  • Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking: Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment: Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

  • You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine).
